newsitem.title: USA: Nichols gets $100 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Nichols gets $100 mln in contracts.

text.p: Nichols Research Corp said that it has recently received new contract awards and contract modifications totaling about $100 million over the next eight years.
Nichols Research was recently awarded a subcontract by AT&T Corp to support a Department of Defense computer modernization program, it said.
Boeing Co granted the company a subcontract to support the Defense Enterprise Integration Services II Program.

Boeing is sharing in this award with five other contractors in the multi-award DEIS II contract which will have a five-year life cycle ceiling of $2.5 billion for the Department of Defense plus $0.5 billion for other federal agencies.
